items.title: Puppy Nursery & First Steps
items.caption: From their very first days, our puppies are raised with care, attention and gentle socialisation, giving each one a warm and loving start before beginning their journey with their new family.

items.title: Grooming & Care
items.caption: Regular grooming is an important part of life with our Bichons. Maintaining the coat between shows is essential for keeping it healthy, clean and in beautiful condition, so each dog is always ready to look its best in the ring.
